column1: # ALIASES ARE THE NAMES A PERSON OR A DISTRO MAY USE THAT ARE NOT THE EXACT ICON ID. They make
# `--system-menu-icon rocky` mean Red Hat, and they keep the resolver's `ID_LIKE` pass useful for derivative IDs
# that are not in `distros.tsv`. A duplicate alias pointing at a different icon is a generator error.
# THE FALLBACK IS ITSELF A NAME, so `--system-menu-icon hamburger` is always valid.
